_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Acne Studios' storefront CSS declares almost no design custom properties (raw/css-vars.json found two app vars: --safe-area-inset-bottom), so every leaf is a "value" leaf carrying a measured value and naming the measurement it came from in "source" (a component + state in raw/components-computed.json, a rule in raw/css-vars.json, or a capture artifact). Values inside "{…}" are unprefixed aliases into the core set. One theme only: the site paints a single light scheme; there is no dark variant to capture.

color.$description: The whole storefront palette: near-pure monochrome with one electric Acne blue (#0018a8) carrying every link, accent action and selected state, its deeper hover step, a pale-blue selected fill, and four warm-grey steps for muted text, borders, hairlines and field fills.

black.source: computed color of nav-item default; backgroundColor of load-more default (raw/components-computed.json)
black.description: Text and the primary button fill. No near-black: the ink is #000.

white.description: Page ground, surfaces, text on dark.

default.source: computed color of footer-link default; backgroundColor of add-to-bag default; borderColor of size-cell-selected (raw/components-computed.json)
default.description: Acne blue: every text link, the ADD TO BAG fill, wishlist border, the picked size cell.

hover.source: computed backgroundColor of add-to-bag hover; color of footer-link hover (raw/components-computed.json)
hover.description: The deeper step every blue element darkens to on hover/pressed.

tint.description: Pale-blue selected fill on the picked size cell.

text.source: computed color of nav-item hover, bag-button default, pdp-color default (raw/components-computed.json)
text.description: Muted text: hover colour of black header items, the bag count, the colourway name.

secondary.source: computed color of subnav-link default; breadcrumb-link hover (raw/components-computed.json)
secondary.description: The second muted step, on the PLP subnav.

border.description: Control borders: the unselected size cells.

hairline.source: computed borderTopColor of info-row default; the header/footer inset rules and row separators in the painted layers (raw/components-computed.json)
hairline.description: The 1px rules everywhere: header/footer edges, footer column rules, menu row separators, info-row boxes.

fill.source: computed backgroundColor of newsletter-field, login-email, search-field default (raw/components-computed.json)
fill.description: Field fills and the mega-menu's alternate row striping.

sans.source: computed fontFamily of nav-item default and every measured text component (raw/components-computed.json)
sans.description: Helvetica Now Text carries the entire storefront.

mono.source: computed fontFamily of pdp-price and size-cell default (raw/components-computed.json)
mono.description: Monospaced numerals: PDP price and the size grid.

12.source: computed fontSize of nav-item, load-more, footer-link, description default (raw/components-computed.json)
12.description: The one label size: nearly every piece of chrome is 12px.

18.source: computed fontSize of newsletter-field, login-title default (raw/components-computed.json)
18.description: Field text and the rare display line (Sign in or register).

regular.source: computed fontWeight of every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)
regular.description: No bold anywhere: hierarchy is size, case and colour only.

tight.source: computed lineHeight of nav-item, load-more, login-title default (raw/components-computed.json)

link.source: computed lineHeight of footer-link, size-guide-link default (raw/components-computed.json)

caps.source: computed letterSpacing of every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)
caps.description: A single uniform tracking on everything.

microCaps.$description: The Acne voice: 12/20 Helvetica Now Text uppercase at 0.3px tracking. Nav, buttons, labels, headings.

body.$description: Same font and size in sentence case: product copy, benefit lines.

price.$description: Monospaced numerals: PDP price and the size grid.

field.$description: The text you type: 18px in the email fields.

title.$description: The one larger line on the sign-in gate.

none.source: computed borderTopLeftRadius of every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)
none.description: Every corner is square. The only curve on the site is the filter rail's 10px radio dot drawn with border-radius:100% — a percentage DTCG cannot carry, noted here.

hairline.source: computed borderTopWidth of size-cell, login-google, search-field, menu-panel (raw/components-computed.json)
hairline.description: Every border is one hairline; thickness never changes between states (colour does).

height.source: rendered height of header default at 1440px (raw/components-computed.json)

heightMobile.source: rendered height of m-header default at 390px (raw/components-computed.json)

height.source: rendered height of add-to-bag, load-more, login-continue, login-google, newsletter-field, login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
height.description: Primary buttons and the big email fields share a 60px rail.

height.source: rendered height of menu-link, search-suggestion, subnav-link, search-field, gift-link defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
height.description: The repeating 30px row: menu links, suggestions, subnav, the small search field, gift-guide bars.

height.source: rendered height of newsletter-field and login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

width.source: rendered width of search-panel and filter-rail defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
width.description: Every right-side drawer (search, filter, bag) opens at 360 wide.

height.source: painted drawer head (div.drawer.flex 360x45) inside search-panel/filter-rail defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

x.source: computed paddingLeft of load-more, add-to-bag defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

y.source: computed paddingTop of load-more, add-to-bag, login-google defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

x.source: computed paddingLeft of newsletter-field, login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

y.source: computed paddingTop of newsletter-field, login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

indent.source: computed paddingLeft of show-more, login-benefit defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
indent.description: The en-dash bullet indent and the SHOW MORE offset.

width.source: computed outlineWidth of add-to-bag, wishlist-button, size-cell focus-visible (raw/components-computed.json)

offset.source: computed outlineOffset of add-to-bag, wishlist-button, size-cell focus-visible (raw/components-computed.json)
offset.description: The ring draws inside the control: a 1px keyline 3px in. On dark fills it is white, on white fills it is the deep blue (#051574) or black. Text links draw no outline: focus is a colour shift only.

instant.source: computed transitionDuration of every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)
instant.description: Hover and focus colour changes are instant; no easing on any measured control.

drawer.source: transition padding-bottom 0.15s on .drawer and the state containers in main.css (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)

slider.source: transition max-height 0.2s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) on .slider in main.css (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)

fade.source: transition opacity 0.5s ease-in-out on [data-component-animation=fade] in main.css (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)

mediumDown.description: Medium-down cut-off: under it the header collapses to Menu + wordmark + bag (the 390px capture).

light.$description: The only theme the storefront paints. Aliases point into core.

page.source: computed backgroundColor of header, filter-rail, search-panel defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

field.source: computed backgroundColor of newsletter-field, login-email, search-field defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

inset.source: the mega-menu's alternate 30px row striping, repeating-linear-gradient in the menu-panel painted layers (raw/components-computed.json)

overlay.source: computed backgroundColor of filter-rail, search-panel defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
overlay.description: Drawers sit on opaque white over the page.

primary.source: computed color of nav-item, pdp-title, description defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

muted.source: computed color of bag-button, pdp-color defaults and nav-item hover (raw/components-computed.json)

link.source: computed color of footer-link, menu-link, search-suggestion, geo-selector defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
link.description: Every navigable text link is Acne blue; black is reserved for labels.

linkHover.source: computed color of footer-link, menu-link, geo-selector hover (raw/components-computed.json)

onDark.source: computed color of load-more, add-to-bag, login-continue defaults and the hero's Gift Guide text node (raw/components-computed.json)

primary.source: computed backgroundColor of load-more, login-continue, show-items defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
primary.description: The black bar: LOAD MORE, CONTINUE, SHOW N ITEMS.

primaryHover.source: computed backgroundColor of load-more, login-continue, show-items hover (raw/components-computed.json)
primaryHover.description: Black bars flip to Acne blue on hover/focus/pressed, not to a darker grey.

accent.description: The one resting-blue action: ADD TO BAG.

onAction.source: computed color of load-more, add-to-bag defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

selected.description: Pale-blue fill marking the picked size.

default.source: computed borderTopColor of login-google, search-field, menu-panel, the filter rail head (raw/components-computed.json)
default.description: The 1px black keyline: outline buttons, the small search field, drawer heads, the mega-menu's top and bottom edge.

hairline.source: computed borderTopColor of info-row, footer, header inset rules (raw/components-computed.json)

field.source: computed borderTopColor of newsletter-field, login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
field.description: The big fields' border is their own fill grey — the field reads as a flat grey rail.

ring.description: 1px solid, offset -3px: deep blue on white surfaces (wishlist button), black on the size cells, white inside the blue/black buttons. Text links show no ring.
